tagline: 柯达旁轴相机，1964 年发布
description: 柯达于1964年推出的旁轴相机。配备Retina-Xenar 45mm f/2.8。快门速度Compur, 1-1/500 + B, with flash sync, cable release and self-timer。使用Manual。感光度12-1250 ASA。Coincident image coupled rangefinder focusing, 1 meter to infinity.。

specs.快门: Compur, 1-1/500 + B, with flash sync, cable release and self-timer
specs.对焦: Coincident image coupled rangefinder focusing, 1 meter to infinity.
specs.闪光灯: AG-1 miniature flashbulb in integrated flashholder, PC socket
specs.英文简介: The Retina IIF, made by Kodak AG between 1964 and 1967[https://web.archive.org/web/20120415011516/http://www.kodak.com/global/en/consumer/products/techInfo/aa13/aa13.shtml Kodak's list of cameras] (archived) in Germany, is a 35mm rangefinder camera.
